subsystems.name: Growing tiers
subsystems.role: stack crops vertically to multiply yield per square metre of floor area.

subsystems.name: Robotic handlers
subsystems.role: perform seeding, transplanting, pruning and harvesting without human hands.

subsystems.name: Perception system
subsystems.role: monitor plant health, growth stage and readiness for harvest.

subsystems.name: AI orchestration
subsystems.role: coordinate robots, schedule tasks and adapt to changing crop needs.
parts: machine-learning models for vision and control

subsystems.name: Environmental control
subsystems.role: maintain optimal conditions for plant growth year-round.

subsystems.name: Logistics
subsystems.role: move trays or harvested produce between growing, processing and packing zones.

buildSteps.title: Design facility and crop plan
buildSteps.detail: Choose crops suited to automation, such as leafy greens and herbs, and design rack layout with clear access for robots.

buildSteps.title: Construct building and racks
buildSteps.detail: Build an insulated structure and install multi-tier racks, typically several metres high, with rails or tracks for robot movement.

buildSteps.title: Install environmental control
buildSteps.detail: Fit LED arrays, HVAC, irrigation and nutrient delivery systems to keep temperature, humidity and CO₂ within setpoints.

buildSteps.title: Deploy robotic hardware
buildSteps.detail: Mount gantries, arms and grippers so they can reach every plant without collisions.

buildSteps.title: Build perception network
buildSteps.detail: Place cameras and sensors to capture images of plants and environmental data continuously.

buildSteps.title: Develop AI control software
buildSteps.detail: Train vision models to identify ripeness, disease and yield, and write scheduling code that assigns tasks to robots.

buildSteps.title: Integrate and calibrate
buildSteps.detail: Test tasks in simulation, then on a single tier, then across the farm, tuning gripper force and motion timing.

buildSteps.title: Pilot with human oversight
buildSteps.detail: Operate with humans monitoring and intervening, collecting data on failures and edge cases.

buildSteps.title: Scale to autonomous operation
buildSteps.detail: Gradually remove human interventions for target crops, keeping remote monitoring for safety and quality.

prerequisites.why: provides the stable growing conditions that make robotic tasks predictable and repeatable.
grippers must handle leaves and fruit without bruising; still an active research area.
AI must reliably detect ripeness, disease and yield in dense foliage under artificial light.
fleets must avoid collisions and share tasks efficiently in confined three-dimensional spaces.
vertical farms depend on artificial light, so lighting efficiency determines economic viability.

pathway.milestone: semi-automated vertical farms with humans handling seeding, harvesting and maintenance
pathway.unlocks: consistent year-round production of leafy greens and herbs close to cities.

pathway.milestone: full automation of individual tasks such as seeding and harvesting for a few crop types
pathway.unlocks: lower labour costs and higher precision in those steps.

pathway.milestone: coordinated robot fleets that handle all tasks for target crops with remote human monitoring
pathway.unlocks: farms that run with minimal on-site staff.

pathway.milestone: zero-human vertical farms for a wider range of crops, integrated with predictive AI
pathway.unlocks: local food production independent of climate and season.
